Dina also introduces us to the Maxwell Centre in the heart of Coldside, Dundee, where they teach local children to grow, care for, harvest and then eat what they produce.

programme.title: A Cook Abroad
programme.desc: Scottish chef Tony Singh travels to India, the country of his ancestors, to trace his family roots and discover whether his mum's Punjabi cooking is the real deal. He begins his journey in Amritsar, which is draped in lights for the festival of Diwali, before braving the treacherous Grand Trunk Road to Delhi, a place Tony has only ever visited twice. Along the way, he fulfils a boyhood dream to meet the Nihang, nomadic Sikh warriors whose cooking techniques are legendary. He receives an exclusive invite to eat and cook with a Maharaja and, as his waistline tightens thanks to the rich Punjabi diet, he burns off the calories at Bollysweat, the fitness phenomenon taking Delhi by storm. As Tony gets under the skin of Punjabi ways, he discovers how the Sikh religion and the region's troubled past have created a food and culture like no other. He ends his epic adventure at the ancestral home in Delhi, where his 93-year-old uncle Ameer opens a window on his family history he will never forget.

programme.title: Eva Longoria: Searching for France
programme.desc: Paris is home to more award-winning pastry chefs than anywhere else in the world. Here, the day revolves around patisserie. Morning begins with the buttery flakes of a croissant. At midday, a baguette tucked under the arm signals lunch. And by the afternoon, mouthwatering sweet treats are savoured like miniature works of art. Resistance is futile, and Eva is seduced by the Paris-Brest, a rum baba, the macaron, a mango cake and dahlia, to name just a few.

programme.title: The Man Who Never Was
programme.desc: Espionage thriller in which a British intelligence officer plans an elaborate hoax in the spring of 1943 to fool the Germans into thinking the Allies are about to invade Greece, not Sicily. The plan calls for the navy to float a dead body carrying false identification and information so that the Germans will pick it up. The first part of the mission succeeds, but will the Nazis take the bait?

programme.title: Homes Under the Hammer
programme.desc: In Scotland, Martel encounters a house with a safety order attached to it, which means certain rooms can’t be accessed. Owain is in south Wales to see a sizeable unit with lots of development potential. In Lincolnshire, Dion is doing all he can to escape the rain!

programme.title: Women's Super League
programme.desc: Coverage of the Women's Super League clash between Arsenal and West Ham United.

programme.title: Flog It!
programme.desc: This edition of Flog It! comes from Longleat in Wiltshire, home to the world-famous safari park and 16th-century Longleat House. In this rather special show, Paul Martin is joined by experts Michael Baggott and Claire Rawle. Whilst picking out a selection of interesting antiques and collectables to be sold at a local auction, Claire spots an unusual Tibetan teapot. This leads to the momentous discovery of other of Tibetan artefacts belonging to the same owner, a collection of controversial historical significance which all ends up going under the hammer. With worldwide interest in these objects, will the Flog It! record for the highest value item sold at auction be broken when the sale goes on to raise thousands of pounds? Paul also gets the chance to explore Longleat House, learning more about its controversial creator and wonderful Elizabethan architecture.

programme.title: Celebrity Race Across the World
programme.desc: In the fourth leg, the teams enter a new frontier, Australia. The sixth largest country on the planet and home to eight distinct climate zones, it’s a land of extreme contrasts. Language barriers may have evaporated, but in their place is a new challenge, the budget, as the country delivers all teams a financial reality check. The teams descend on the fourth checkpoint in the tightest race yet, with a foot race to the sign-in book.

programme.title: This Farming Life
programme.desc: Spring is in the air, bringing newborn livestock. In North Uist, Carianne spends her days on the tiny island of Vallay in search of new Highland calves. When one calf is discovered without a mother, Carianne must turn detective to reunite them. In Inverkip, Rachel and Camy are heading to the hills to help any of their Cheviot sheep in need of a midwife. And in South Ayrshire, the Barclay family are working round the clock to ensure their flock of Beltex ewes safely deliver this year’s crop of lambs.

programme.title: Eva Longoria: Searching for France
programme.desc: Eva takes a boat trip down the Seine with chef Eric Ripert and writer Lindsey Tramuta. Together, they explore the story of French gastronomy through a seven-course fine dining meal. At the heart of this delicious story is one man – Auguste Escoffier. He dominated every aspect of gastronomy, inventing and improving hundreds of classic dishes, bringing order to chaos in the kitchen with his military-style brigade and revolutionising front of house. Escoffier put French haute cuisine on the global map.

programme.title: Ireland with Simon Reeve
programme.desc: Starting at the spectacular Giant's Causeway in Northern Ireland, Simon travels down the east coast to the great and rapidly changing cities of Belfast and Dublin. He ends his journey in the stunning Wicklow Mountains.

programme.title: Mortimer & Whitehouse: Gone Fishing
programme.desc: Paul and Bob travel to County Tyrone to fish at Baronscourt Estate, hoping to catch a pike of a lifetime. They have access to two beautiful and secluded loughs, set in over 130 acres of rolling countryside, and the private use of one rowing boat – what could possibly go wrong? Pike are wily fish, always hiding in the dark reeds and waiting to ambush their prey. Bob has a fail-safe method to try, but will the duo be able to outwit the elusive creatures?

programme.title: A Course Called Ireland
programme.desc: After weeks of travelling, filming and constant attention, life on the road is taking its toll on Bill. With brothers Joel and Johnny along for the ride, family offers an escape from fame. The Murrays reflect on losing their father young, and how caddying and golf bound nine siblings together. By the time they reach Cruit Island in Donegal, family reflection gives way to golfing rivalry.

programme.title: Rewarding
programme.desc: Nicola's news is still gnawing at Sinead's brain. Determined to turn things around, she's scheduled a training day, followed by mandatory team-building drinks. The planned training is temporarily derailed by the news that Joe's grandad Lips, a local criminal, has died, and the funeral clashes with the training. Sinead manages to blackmail Nicola into accompanying Joe to the funeral. Training hasn't even started before it goes wrong. Francis overhears trainers Neil and Polly badmouthing the team, and declares war - he, Fidelma and Cyril bet on who can break the jobsworths first. Winner drinks for free at the team-building.

programme.title: Sunday Politics Northern Ireland
programme.desc: Mark Carruthers looks at the political developments of the week and questions policymakers on the key issues.

programme.title: Uncanny
programme.desc: Lindsey and her family move to a new-build house on the Isle of Thanet in Kent. For years, they live happily at the property, but then their quiet lives are suddenly rocked by a series of terrifying events: repeated footsteps every night, door handles that move by themselves and the appearance of a cloaked, hunched, shadowy figure. Who is the figure? Could the answers lie beneath their feet?

programme.title: Live at the Apollo
programme.desc: Tim Renkow welcomes comedians Janine Harouni and Stuart Goldsmith to the stage.

programme.title: Suzie Lee's Great Food Made Simple
programme.desc: Suzie visits Tully Mill in Co Fermanagh and is inspired to make a chocolate brownie with a chocolate mousse and a cherry compote.

programme.title: Blue Velvet
programme.desc: When the discovery of a severed ear in a field leads a small-town college student to a bewitching nightclub singer, he finds himself lost in a dark underworld of fear and depravity. A disturbing, unique exploration of the dark side of American suburbia from director David Lynch.

programme.title: Question Time
programme.desc: Fiona Bruce presents an hour of debate from Worthing, with politicians, commentators and members of the public. The UK government has backed plans by former minister Alan Milburn for sweeping reforms to prevent 'losing a generation' of young people to a life on benefits, and this week’s EU-UK talks are going 'down to the wire' according to Downing Street. Fiona Bruce presents an hour of topical debate from Worthing, debating Neets, rejoining the EU and old Brexit wounds, the housing crisis and Labour’s housing targets, and which politician, in the panel’s opinion, would make a good Bond villain. On the panel are Labour’s former foreign secretary David Lammy; the Conservatives’ shadow work and pensions minister Joe Robertson; Adrian Ramsay of the Green Party; the entrepreneur Alex Depledge; and the Times columnist Fraser Nelson.

programme.title: Honey
programme.desc: Martha is annoyed after Kurt steals their joint credit for locating Kamilla, and she vows to gain access to the scientist alone. A competitive Kurt promises to do the same. Friedrich is ordered by his boss Schimmel to ramp up his efforts to locate Greta, believing she is the key to the Hermann Metzl case. Eager for a win, Martha and Kurt attempt to insinuate their way into Friedrich’s confidence to find Greta. Stung by his reaction, Martha steals a prized possession.

programme.title: This is BBC Two
programme.desc: Highlights of programmes on BBC Two.

programme.title: Bargain Hunt
programme.desc: Eric Knowles visits Nottingham’s Gothic revival cathedral to learn how conservators are revealing 19th-century artwork under decades of plaster and paint. Designed in 1842 by architect Augustus Pugin, the cathedral’s interior was whitewashed in the 1960s. Pugin is widely admired for his work on some of Britain’s most famous buildings, including the Palace of Westminster. Conservator Ana Logreira shows Eric how they are using digitally created stencils to renovate the cathedral’s historic interior. At Southwell Racecourse in Nottinghamshire, red team uncle and niece Russ and Lily are up against twin sisters Angie and Tamsin in blue. With just 60 minutes to buy three items, Russ makes an early pit stop at a stall selling boxed toy cars. Meanwhile, a marcasite brooch catches the sisters’ attention, but expert Irita Marriott isn’t convinced it will dazzle the bidders. Trying to hammer out a profit for the teams in Nottingham is auctioneer Hettie Jago, who has her eye on the jewellery among the lots.

programme.title: Blue Planet III
programme.desc: A look at the surprising connections between the world's oceans, from the icy worlds of the poles to unexpected coasts closer to home.

programme.title: Match of the Day
programme.desc: Highlights of Sunday’s two Premier League games as Liverpool take on Manchester United at Anfield and high-flying Brighton go to Hull City, a first league meeting between the two teams since 2016, when both were in the Championship. Kelly Cates presents.

programme.title: BBC News
programme.desc: Twenty-four hours a day, the latest national and international stories as they break.

programme.title: Politics Live
programme.desc: The big political issues of the day.

programme.title: Impossible
programme.desc: Game show in which 24 players compete to score points by answering questions correctly. However, they must avoid the Impossible answers, otherwise they will be eliminated from the show until the next day. In each episode, there are three rounds, and the three highest scorers from each round play against each other in the final. The winner of this battle faces a £10,000 question.

programme.title: Bridge of Lies
programme.desc: Ross Kemp presents the quiz show where a team of four – in this episode, family and friends Amy, JP, Nic and Alan – take on the Bridge of Lies. One by one, they all face the Bridge, choosing who faces each crossing depending on the question category. Each crossing has 32 potential steps, including 22 truths and ten lies. They must cross the Bridge by stepping on the truths and avoiding the lies, earning money for each correct answer. Step on a lie and the Bridge will halve their money, step on three lies, and they are out of the game. There is always a safe path across the Bridge. They just have to find it. Once they have each faced the Bridge on their own, those who have been successful will join forces to face the final crossing for a chance to take home the cash.

programme.title: Coast to Coast Food Festival
programme.desc: Colin Murray discovers a brown sauce revival and the advantages of getting fish from a fishmonger as he visits Derry/Londonderry’s Walled City Market. Briony May Williams explores how Somerset is rivalling France in cheese productions, and Onkar Singh Purewal discovers the secrets of beekeeping. Chef Julie Lin is in Dundee, finding out how bakers keep up with demand around the clock.

programme.title: Great Coastal Railway Journeys
programme.desc: Michael starts a new railway journey in Newcastle, heading north to Berwick-upon-Tweed. His route takes in the River Tyne, Hadrian’s Wall, a former mining village and the fishing port of Amble.

programme.title: Trawlermen: Hunting the Catch
programme.desc: As Storm Arwen hits UK waters, Victory Rose decides when to take shelter from the storm. Crabber Siwrengale has three days to make a week’s wages, and Revival goes in search of North Sea prawns.

programme.title: Antiques Roadshow
programme.desc: Michael Aspel and the team head for Coughton Court in Warwickshire, where the experts get excited about an Agatha Christie letter and a rare china figure of the Queen on horseback.

programme.title: Flog It!
programme.desc: This episode comes from Oxford Union, right in the heart of central Oxford. Paul Martin is joined by experts Christina Trevanion and Will Axon. Together the team pick out a selection of interesting antiques and collectables to be sold at a local auction. Will uncovers some salacious etchings by a very famous artist, while Christina finds a unique autograph book, but will it reach for the stars or languish at the bottom of the bill? Paul also gets the chance to explore behind the scenes at Oxford Union to discover a few of the famous faces who debated in the chamber.

programme.title: House of Games
programme.desc: Every day this week, celebrity contestants Catherine Bohart, Chesney Hawkes, Rebecca Keatley and Jason Mohammad take on a series of quiz rounds selected by the host, Michael Sheen. A daily winner is declared following a quickfire round at the end of each show, and the scores are tallied across the week, resulting in an overall champion being crowned on Friday. Will the winning stars opt for the much-coveted House of Games wheelie luggage, or will they be tempted by the House of Games skateboard?

programme.title: Strictly - It Takes Two
programme.desc: Ellie Taylor kicks off the week by having an exclusive chat with the latest couple to bow out from Strictly. Friday’s all-star panel return to break down the weekend action from the Tower Ballroom.

programme.title: Global Eye
programme.desc: A weekly programme from the BBC World Service, bringing forensic journalism from all corners of the world by BBC Eye, the World Service's critically acclaimed investigative unit, and featuring expert global correspondents getting to the heart of the biggest international stories. In this episode: Nomsa Maseko reports from South Africa, where a series of shocking murders has exposed the dangers that women face. Plus BBC Eye reveals new evidence showing how scouts, agencies and powerful fashion figures helped Jeffrey Epstein gain access to young women after his conviction for sex offences. And BBC Urdu joins women in Pakistan who are challenging traditional barriers by taking to the road on motorbikes, gaining new independence in a country where riding has long been considered off-limits to many women.

programme.title: Mastermind
programme.desc: In another heat, four contenders take on the famous black chair, answering questions on their chosen specialist subjects to earn a place in the semi-finals. Clive Myrie hosts and asks questions on Marilyn Monroe, the influential author Katherine Mansfield, the award-winning television series The Sopranos and the German mathematician Carl Friedrich Gauss.

programme.title: Only Connect
programme.desc: Victoria Coren Mitchell hosts the quiz where knowledge only gets you so far – the vital extra ingredients are logic and lateral thinking. It’s another rematch: these teams may know each other from before, but they’d better not drop their guard, because the questions are ramping up. For example: what connects Toe Martin, Shadow Fury, Tonsil Draper and Jiminy Stokes?

programme.title: University Challenge
programme.desc: In another second-round match, the team from Bristol take on their neighbours on the Avon at the University of Bath for a place in the quarter-finals. Amol Rajan asks the questions.

programme.title: Lucy Worsley's Keys to the Castle
programme.desc: Lucy Worsley travels to Venice, where she is given the keys to the Doge’s Palace, a multi-purpose building that controlled Venice’s empire for a thousand years. She has a close shave in the dreaded Council of Ten's torture chamber, discovers a 24-carat gold staircase that leads to one of the biggest rooms in Europe, and encounters hidden doors and secret messages.

programme.title: Ceolta
programme.desc: Cuireann Fiachna Ó Braonáin agus Eve Belle rogha agus togha de stíleanna ceoil i láthair i dTeach na Cúirte i mBeannchar, Co. An Dúin, a léiríonn saol ilghnéitheach ceoil an cheantair. Tugann léirithe ó Winnie Ama, And So I Watch You From Afar agus ó aíonna speisialta Hothouse Flowers réimse iontach fuaimeanna dúinn - guthanna machnamhacha, na foinn iar-rac, agus an spiorad cruthaitheach á léiriú lena linn. Fiachna Ó Braonáin and Eve Belle introduce an eclectic mix of musical styles at The Court House in Bangor, County Down. Performances from Winnie Ama, And So I Watch You From Afar, and special guests Hothouse Flowers bring us an extraordinary range of sounds, from soulful vocals to post-rock instrumentals, capturing the creative spirit found in the local music scene.

programme.title: Newsnight
programme.desc: Insights and global interviews on the news stories of the day. With Katie Razzall.

programme.title: Blood
programme.desc: Sibling detectives Joe and Chrissie are on the hunt for 12-year-old Angela's murderer. One drunken night, feeling frustrated by the case and overprotective of his own daughter Miriam, Joe along with Chrissie drives the prime suspect Jason Burleigh into the woods and kills him. A reworking of Bill Gallagher’s hard-hitting thriller for the big screen.

programme.title: Panorama
programme.desc: Warren Arter was seen as a star detective in the Metropolitan Police, but he was also a sexual predator. He used his position running a rape and sexual offences unit to groom and sexually exploit vulnerable women whose cases he investigated. But the Met missed a string of opportunities to stop Arter and then suspended him on full pay for almost seven years before finally dismissing him for drug offences in 2023. In 2024, he was with his wife Rebekah when she died in a hotel room in Barbados in mysterious circumstances. Reporter Noel Titheradge investigates the case that has been called the Met's 'dirty secret' and tracks down new witnesses who tell him what really happened. Could Rebekah's death have been prevented? And why didn't the Met act sooner to stop the predator in its ranks?

programme.title: This City Is Ours
programme.desc: As their shared enemy finally comes to light, Michael and the Phelans are forced to come together to survive. Meanwhile, a new trauma opens old wounds, pushing Diana towards a decision that will change everything.

programme.title: This is BBC Two
programme.desc: Highlights of programmes on BBC Two.

programme.title: Piripenguins
programme.desc: Flutter buys a new fishy pet from slippery salesman Mervyn, but the Piripenguins get stuck in its gloopy slime. Can the friends find a solution to their sticky situation?

programme.title: Big Lizard
programme.desc: Cosima takes over Dad's mission to film a unique underwater plant. But his special camera proves harder to operate than she'd thought, and Big Lizard keeps getting distracted.

programme.title: The Weasy Family
programme.desc: Weasy falls in love with a gold watch, but it belongs to the farmer...

programme.title: Super Happy Magic Forest
programme.desc: Mr Friendlyface is acting very strangely indeed. He refuses to stamp any of Admin Bunny’s documents, keeps getting distracted by butterflies, and seems oddly happy! The heroes are extremely suspicious and decide that someone must have swapped him with a doppelganger. Now they must quest to find out where the real Friendlyface is and get him back before the forest descends into total chaos.

programme.title: Grizzy and the Lemmings
programme.desc: The Lemmings lay hands on an ancient console, and Grizzy is transported into the game.

programme.title: Duck and Frog
programme.desc: Duck and Frog are working at a supermarket alongside Toad and Flamingo, who keep ruining Duck and Frog's hard work to make them look bad. Why are they being so mean?

programme.title: Pokémon Horizons
programme.desc: Roy, Crocalor and Kilowattrel take on Drayton in a spirited rematch.

programme.title: Winx Club - The Magic Is Back
programme.desc: The Winx indulge in a day of fun at the amusement park in Magixia but are suddenly attacked by Vexius. This time, however, they may be able to stop him with the help of unexpected allies...

programme.title: The Next Step: Cheer
programme.desc: When a legendary coach abruptly leaves a highly successful cheerleading gym, the team are left in disarray, The Next Step’s Kenzie steps in to take over what’s left of the team, desperate to prove she is more than just a dancer, and that she can build this rag-tag group of athletes into a contender for nationals.

programme.title: Newsround
programme.desc: Topical news magazine for children.

programme.title: Blue Peter
programme.desc: Meet new BP presenter Leo, who takes to the skies in an incredible skydive challenge to earn his Blue Peter Badge - can he achieve a world record on his very first show?

programme.title: Deadly 60
programme.desc: Steve Backshall heads to Oman, where he abseils to a verreaux's eagle nest, tracks down wolves and swims alongside a super pod made up of over 100 dolphins.

programme.title: Gardeners' World
programme.desc: Monty celebrates the rewards of winter gardening - sharing ideas, inspiration and timely jobs to keep gardeners busy now, while reminding us that warmer days lie ahead. At Longmeadow, he has hellebores to plant, peas to sow and practical advice on propagating roses. Sue Kent gets to work on her allotment, where there’s always plenty to do during the colder months, including some clever composting. Jamie Butterworth takes a tour of one of Somerset’s most imaginative topiary gardens. In Belfast, a local community tells the tale of how their once neglected alleyway has become their pride and joy. Carol Klein unearths some radical new thinking on how flowers may be adapting to climate change, while Rekha Mistry travels to RHS Garden Bridgewater to see how garden varieties of tomato and mint are put to the test.

programme.title: Naturewatch
programme.desc: The team dives into some intriguing autumn mysteries: why don’t seals drown? What is the UK’s most deadly mushroom? And what extraordinary creature has the power to keep autumn leaves alive?

programme.title: My Life at Christmas with Anita Rani
programme.desc: Anita Rani pays a Christmas visit to Baroness Floella Benjamin, a pivotal figure to generations of young TV viewers. Born in Trinidad and Tobago, Floella arrived in London at the age of ten as part of the Windrush generation. Together, they retrace that journey and reflect on Dame Floella's extraordinary life shaped by faith and the festive season: from stage actor and iconic Play School presenter to businesswoman, child rights campaigner, dame and baroness, and even playing a role in King Charles III's coronation.

programme.title: Marcus Wareing's Tales from a Kitchen Garden
programme.desc: Marcus plans to bring in some ducks, but things aren’t as simple as they seem as he heads out onto the lake to create a new home for them. Heading to Devon, he discovers the perfect breed for the smallholding and picks up some top tips and tricks on how to rear them. Back on the farm, the bounty of the kitchen garden inspires a visit to a local community fridge to learn more about how it works, before a neighbour pops over to give him a lesson on what is edible and growing wild in the hedgerows and bushes that surround the smallholding. Once the new ducks arrive and are safely in their new home, he cooks up a fantastic feast inspired by a British classic, the ploughman's lunch.

programme.title: Nadiya’s Everyday Baking
programme.desc: Nadiya shows off her easy celebration bakes, which range from a glittering meringue layer cake to a slow-cooked lamb curry fit for a feast, with an American-inspired seafood extravaganza.

programme.title: The Importance of Being Earnest
programme.desc: Screen adaptation of Oscar Wilde's celebrated play in which two Victorian gentlemen both adopt a double identity under the name of Ernest and end up in trouble when they both turn up at the same country house one weekend.

programme.title: Strangers on a Train
programme.desc: Alfred Hitchcock's suspense classic about two men who plot a perfect murder. When tennis pro Guy Haines meets smooth-talking Bruno Antony in the bar of a train, he finds the stranger sympathetic with his desire to be rid of his clinging wife. The sinister Bruno then proposes that they swap murders: Bruno will murder Guy's wife, and Guy will do away with Bruno's father. From Patricia Highsmith's novel.

programme.title: Flog It!
programme.desc: The programme comes from the Platform in Morecambe, Lancashire, which in its day was the main station bringing holidaymakers to the town. Antiques experts Charles Hanson and Catherine Southon find treasures to take to auction, including a vintage Rolex watch. Paul Martin discovers the rags-to-riches story of the town's most famous son - Eric Morecambe.

programme.title: Celebrity Antiques Road Trip
programme.desc: Broadcasting legend Bob Harris and queen of motor sports Suzi Perry burn rubber across south east England in a racy 1974 Ford Escort RS 2000. But can they flip antiques for profit? Steering them in the right direction are doyens Margie Cooper and Raj Bisram, both veteran road trippers and rivals to the core. What starts out as a hunt for music and travel collectibles changes tack very early on. Bob falls for a pair of romantic champagne flutes in a love heart stand, while Suzy steps back in time when she discovers a Japanese glass fishing float. Along the way, they learn to raise their profile through the art of silhouette portraiture, with some amazing results. But at the auction, there can be only one winner. Will Bob reach the number one spot, or will Suzy be racing for the stars?

programme.title: The Eagle Has Landed
programme.desc: All-action World War II adventure. On the morning of 6 November 1943, the military authorities in Berlin receive a simple message - 'The Eagle Has Landed'. In a daring kidnap attempt, a small force of crack German paratroopers are poised to snatch Winston Churchill and return with him to Germany. If they succeed in their mission, it could alter the course of the war. Who can stop them?

programme.title: 40 Hidden Music Treasures at the BBC
programme.desc: A collection of 40 rarely seen musical moments that don't often get to escape from the BBC vaults. Featuring Roachford on The Roland Rat Show, David Bowie on Friday Night with Jonathan Ross, Mary J Blige appearing on Davina McCall's chat show and one of Gloria Estefan's several star turns on the Royal Variety Show over the years.

programme.title: 40 Hidden Music Treasures at the BBC
programme.desc: Another deep dive into the BBC’s music archives, where the musical map is pointed away from Top of the Pops on a quest to uncover 40 rarely seen performances and hidden gems. Featuring Bronski Beat’s first BBC performance of Smalltown Boy, Rihanna’s rockier version of Umbrella, Sophie Ellis-Bextor covering Pulp’s Do You Remember the First Time? and Kate Bush pairing up for a tango during Hounds of Love. These tucked-away treats and many, many more make this a journey that musical fans are certain to treasure.

programme.title: 40 Hidden Music Treasures at the BBC
programme.desc: Expect the unexpected on this journey through the BBC’s magical music archives, a Top 40 with a difference. In a Top of the Pops-free-zone, these are the surprising songs and rare performances that aren't seen every day, taken from shows that may have been forgotten - but that definitely deserve to see daylight once again. And whilst some of the musical moments may have been hidden away, the talents involved have always been prominent - ranging from Jimi Hendrix to MC Hammer, from Dusty to Tammy, and from The Beach Boys to The Pet Shop Boys.

programme.title: Celebrity Race Across the World
programme.desc: The third leg of the race sees the teams leave behind the ancient jungles of Borneo to reach the island of Sulawesi, an Indonesian wonderland that lies far from the tourist trail. But with the end of Ramadan fast approaching, the teams must negotiate the crowds heading home for Eid al-Fitr.

programme.title: Bill's Included
programme.desc: When Bill’s wife walks out on him for the gardener, he’s left lonely and broke. In the hope of turning his life around, he lets out his spare rooms to four students. Bill is thrilled to meet his new housemates: Christian, Zahra, Hettie, and James. But when Christian keeps leaving the fridge door open, Bill has to come up with a scheme to get it shut without ruining his image as a relaxed, fun landlord. Bill’s best mate, Drew, gives him the idea to deploy an anonymous suggestions box, but this backfires when the students’ requests lead to the worst night’s sleep of his life. Bill’s neighbour and secret crush, Siobhan, suggests sending over her intimidating husband, Martin, to complain on Bill’s behalf, but when this ruse is exposed, Bill fears the students will leave him, just like his wife did. He’s grateful to learn that not only do they have nowhere else to live but they forgive him, since university is all about starting over. For better or worse, his new life truly has begun.

programme.title: This is BBC Two
programme.desc: Highlights of programmes on BBC Two.

programme.title: Countryfile
programme.desc: Hamza Yassin heads to a secret location in Scotland’s Southern Uplands to join a dedicated team on an exciting mission to protect the fastest animal in the world - the peregrine falcon. Getting up close to three chicks, he discovers how DNA sampling is helping to tackle the theft of these remarkable birds. Along the way, the programme revisits memorable Countryfile wildlife encounters, from dolphins off Anglesey to spectacular starling murmurations at Newport Wetlands.

programme.title: BBC News
programme.desc: Twenty-four hours a day, the latest national and international stories as they break.

programme.title: Landward
programme.desc: A special episode from north Sutherland at the top of the Scottish mainland. Dougie steps out into the Flow Country, a vast expanse of blanket peat bog, where he charts the changes in its land use and its recent designation as a Unesco World Heritage site. Arlene catches up with sheep farmer Joyce Campbell to see how she has made the switch from traditional hill farming to regenerative agriculture. Arlene also visits Strath Halladale, where she meets a man who gave up city life to run the family croft 37 years ago. She finds out how he has built a thriving timber business and brought jobs to the area. And at Loch Hope, Leanna meets the biologists working to protect precious sea trout populations.

programme.title: Beechgrove Garden
programme.desc: Indonesian cook and gardener Dina Watt takes us from garden fork to table fork. Dina cultivates to cook in her Banchory garden, creating tasty and innovative dishes with her homegrown produce and adding an Indonesian twist to her local crops. Dina also introduces us to the Maxwell Centre in the heart of Coldside, Dundee, where they teach local children to grow, care for, harvest and then eat what they produce.

programme.title: A Cook Abroad
programme.desc: Scottish chef Tony Singh travels to India, the country of his ancestors, to trace his family roots and discover whether his mum's Punjabi cooking is the real deal. He begins his journey in Amritsar, which is draped in lights for the festival of Diwali, before braving the treacherous Grand Trunk Road to Delhi, a place Tony has only ever visited twice. Along the way, he fulfils a boyhood dream to meet the Nihang, nomadic Sikh warriors whose cooking techniques are legendary. He receives an exclusive invite to eat and cook with a Maharaja and, as his waistline tightens thanks to the rich Punjabi diet, he burns off the calories at Bollysweat, the fitness phenomenon taking Delhi by storm. As Tony gets under the skin of Punjabi ways, he discovers how the Sikh religion and the region's troubled past have created a food and culture like no other. He ends his epic adventure at the ancestral home in Delhi, where his 93-year-old uncle Ameer opens a window on his family history he will never forget.

programme.title: Eva Longoria: Searching for France
programme.desc: Paris is home to more award-winning pastry chefs than anywhere else in the world. Here, the day revolves around patisserie. Morning begins with the buttery flakes of a croissant. At midday, a baguette tucked under the arm signals lunch. And by the afternoon, mouthwatering sweet treats are savoured like miniature works of art. Resistance is futile, and Eva is seduced by the Paris-Brest, a rum baba, the macaron, a mango cake and dahlia, to name just a few.

programme.title: The Man Who Never Was
programme.desc: Espionage thriller in which a British intelligence officer plans an elaborate hoax in the spring of 1943 to fool the Germans into thinking the Allies are about to invade Greece, not Sicily. The plan calls for the navy to float a dead body carrying false identification and information so that the Germans will pick it up. The first part of the mission succeeds, but will the Nazis take the bait?

programme.title: Homes Under the Hammer
programme.desc: In Scotland, Martel encounters a house with a safety order attached to it, which means certain rooms can’t be accessed. Owain is in south Wales to see a sizeable unit with lots of development potential. In Lincolnshire, Dion is doing all he can to escape the rain!

programme.title: Women's Super League
programme.desc: Coverage of the Women's Super League clash between Arsenal and West Ham United.

programme.title: Flog It!
programme.desc: This edition of Flog It! comes from Longleat in Wiltshire, home to the world-famous safari park and 16th-century Longleat House. In this rather special show, Paul Martin is joined by experts Michael Baggott and Claire Rawle. Whilst picking out a selection of interesting antiques and collectables to be sold at a local auction, Claire spots an unusual Tibetan teapot. This leads to the momentous discovery of other of Tibetan artefacts belonging to the same owner, a collection of controversial historical significance which all ends up going under the hammer. With worldwide interest in these objects, will the Flog It! record for the highest value item sold at auction be broken when the sale goes on to raise thousands of pounds? Paul also gets the chance to explore Longleat House, learning more about its controversial creator and wonderful Elizabethan architecture.

programme.title: Celebrity Race Across the World
programme.desc: In the fourth leg, the teams enter a new frontier, Australia. The sixth largest country on the planet and home to eight distinct climate zones, it’s a land of extreme contrasts. Language barriers may have evaporated, but in their place is a new challenge, the budget, as the country delivers all teams a financial reality check. The teams descend on the fourth checkpoint in the tightest race yet, with a foot race to the sign-in book.

programme.title: This Farming Life
programme.desc: Spring is in the air, bringing newborn livestock. In North Uist, Carianne spends her days on the tiny island of Vallay in search of new Highland calves. When one calf is discovered without a mother, Carianne must turn detective to reunite them. In Inverkip, Rachel and Camy are heading to the hills to help any of their Cheviot sheep in need of a midwife. And in South Ayrshire, the Barclay family are working round the clock to ensure their flock of Beltex ewes safely deliver this year’s crop of lambs.

programme.title: Eva Longoria: Searching for France
programme.desc: Eva takes a boat trip down the Seine with chef Eric Ripert and writer Lindsey Tramuta. Together, they explore the story of French gastronomy through a seven-course fine dining meal. At the heart of this delicious story is one man – Auguste Escoffier. He dominated every aspect of gastronomy, inventing and improving hundreds of classic dishes, bringing order to chaos in the kitchen with his military-style brigade and revolutionising front of house. Escoffier put French haute cuisine on the global map.

programme.title: Ireland with Simon Reeve
programme.desc: Starting at the spectacular Giant's Causeway in Northern Ireland, Simon travels down the east coast to the great and rapidly changing cities of Belfast and Dublin. He ends his journey in the stunning Wicklow Mountains.

programme.title: Mortimer & Whitehouse: Gone Fishing
programme.desc: Paul and Bob travel to County Tyrone to fish at Baronscourt Estate, hoping to catch a pike of a lifetime. They have access to two beautiful and secluded loughs, set in over 130 acres of rolling countryside, and the private use of one rowing boat – what could possibly go wrong? Pike are wily fish, always hiding in the dark reeds and waiting to ambush their prey. Bob has a fail-safe method to try, but will the duo be able to outwit the elusive creatures?

programme.title: A Course Called Ireland
programme.desc: After weeks of travelling, filming and constant attention, life on the road is taking its toll on Bill. With brothers Joel and Johnny along for the ride, family offers an escape from fame. The Murrays reflect on losing their father young, and how caddying and golf bound nine siblings together. By the time they reach Cruit Island in Donegal, family reflection gives way to golfing rivalry.

programme.title: Uncanny
programme.desc: Lindsey and her family move to a new-build house on the Isle of Thanet in Kent. For years, they live happily at the property, but then their quiet lives are suddenly rocked by a series of terrifying events: repeated footsteps every night, door handles that move by themselves and the appearance of a cloaked, hunched, shadowy figure. Who is the figure? Could the answers lie beneath their feet?

programme.title: Get Out
programme.desc: Chris and his girlfriend Rose head to upstate New York to meet her parents for the first time. When they arrive, Rose's parents are genial and welcoming to him, but the more time he spends with them and their quiet, obedient servants, the more Chris feels that something is very, very wrong.

programme.title: Blue Velvet
programme.desc: When the discovery of a severed ear in a field leads a small-town college student to a bewitching nightclub singer, he finds himself lost in a dark underworld of fear and depravity. A disturbing, unique exploration of the dark side of American suburbia from director David Lynch.

programme.title: Question Time
programme.desc: Fiona Bruce presents an hour of debate from Worthing, with politicians, commentators and members of the public. The UK government has backed plans by former minister Alan Milburn for sweeping reforms to prevent 'losing a generation' of young people to a life on benefits, and this week’s EU-UK talks are going 'down to the wire' according to Downing Street. Fiona Bruce presents an hour of topical debate from Worthing, debating Neets, rejoining the EU and old Brexit wounds, the housing crisis and Labour’s housing targets, and which politician, in the panel’s opinion, would make a good Bond villain. On the panel are Labour’s former foreign secretary David Lammy; the Conservatives’ shadow work and pensions minister Joe Robertson; Adrian Ramsay of the Green Party; the entrepreneur Alex Depledge; and the Times columnist Fraser Nelson.

programme.title: Honey
programme.desc: Martha is annoyed after Kurt steals their joint credit for locating Kamilla, and she vows to gain access to the scientist alone. A competitive Kurt promises to do the same. Friedrich is ordered by his boss Schimmel to ramp up his efforts to locate Greta, believing she is the key to the Hermann Metzl case. Eager for a win, Martha and Kurt attempt to insinuate their way into Friedrich’s confidence to find Greta. Stung by his reaction, Martha steals a prized possession.

programme.title: This is BBC Two
programme.desc: Highlights of programmes on BBC Two.

programme.title: Bargain Hunt
programme.desc: Eric Knowles visits Nottingham’s Gothic revival cathedral to learn how conservators are revealing 19th-century artwork under decades of plaster and paint. Designed in 1842 by architect Augustus Pugin, the cathedral’s interior was whitewashed in the 1960s. Pugin is widely admired for his work on some of Britain’s most famous buildings, including the Palace of Westminster. Conservator Ana Logreira shows Eric how they are using digitally created stencils to renovate the cathedral’s historic interior. At Southwell Racecourse in Nottinghamshire, red team uncle and niece Russ and Lily are up against twin sisters Angie and Tamsin in blue. With just 60 minutes to buy three items, Russ makes an early pit stop at a stall selling boxed toy cars. Meanwhile, a marcasite brooch catches the sisters’ attention, but expert Irita Marriott isn’t convinced it will dazzle the bidders. Trying to hammer out a profit for the teams in Nottingham is auctioneer Hettie Jago, who has her eye on the jewellery among the lots.

programme.title: Impossible
programme.desc: Game show in which 24 players compete to score points by answering questions correctly. However, they must avoid the Impossible answers, otherwise they will be eliminated from the show until the next day. In each episode, there are three rounds, and the three highest scorers from each round play against each other in the final. The winner of this battle faces a £10,000 question.

programme.title: Bridge of Lies
programme.desc: Ross Kemp presents the quiz show where a team of four – in this episode, family and friends Amy, JP, Nic and Alan – take on the Bridge of Lies. One by one, they all face the Bridge, choosing who faces each crossing depending on the question category. Each crossing has 32 potential steps, including 22 truths and ten lies. They must cross the Bridge by stepping on the truths and avoiding the lies, earning money for each correct answer. Step on a lie and the Bridge will halve their money, step on three lies, and they are out of the game. There is always a safe path across the Bridge. They just have to find it. Once they have each faced the Bridge on their own, those who have been successful will join forces to face the final crossing for a chance to take home the cash.

Chef Julie Lin is in Dundee, finding out how bakers keep up with demand around the clock.

programme.title: Great Coastal Railway Journeys
programme.desc: Michael starts a new railway journey in Newcastle, heading north to Berwick-upon-Tweed. His route takes in the River Tyne, Hadrian’s Wall, a former mining village and the fishing port of Amble.

Paul also gets the chance to explore behind the scenes at Oxford Union to discover a few of the famous faces who debated in the chamber.

In this episode: Nomsa Maseko reports from South Africa, where a series of shocking murders has exposed the dangers that women face. Plus BBC Eye reveals new evidence showing how scouts, agencies and powerful fashion figures helped Jeffrey Epstein gain access to young women after his conviction for sex offences. And BBC Urdu joins women in Pakistan who are challenging traditional barriers by taking to the road on motorbikes, gaining new independence in a country where riding has long been considered off-limits to many women.

programme.desc: Elsee plays I-spy during a birthday party with her friends Ethan and Oscar.

programme.title: Maddie + Triggs
programme.desc: Maddie and Triggs are bored. It's been raining for what seems like forever and they really want to play outside! They have exhausted the ideas for playing indoors. Now that it is completely quiet in the house, they discover some sounds they have never noticed before. The duo shrink down and explore a treasure trove of new sounds.

programme.title: Monster Makes
programme.desc: Rebecca and Murphi are trying to come up with a new move to perfect their competition dance routine. They take a break for an ice-cold monster shake and find time to create a bottle penguin. The Mini Monsters demonstrate how to make everlasting sandcastles, and Rebecca’s aunt calls from space - where she has made some alien friends. The Recycling Express arrives with empty tissue boxes, inspiring a mega monster make – a funny pineapple puppet.

programme.title: Raa Raa the Noisy Lion
programme.desc: There's a storm in the Jingly Jangly Jungle but no-one is sure what the loud thumps coming from the sky are. Raa Raa sets off to find out.

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: Bluey and Bingo want a pet. To show them how much work they'd be in for, Dad gets to transform his hand into their old friend Shaun, a chaotic, undisciplined Emu with a taste for trouble.

programme.title: Hey Duggee
programme.desc: Roly has lost his best potato, but Duggee finds it using his sense of smell. But what is a sense? Time for the Squirrels to learn about the five senses and earn their senses badge.

programme.title: Teeny Tiny Creatures
programme.desc: Harriet wants to find out all about blue tits in today’s episode. Chantelle visits a school and discovers that they have a bird box which is currently home to a family of blue tits, whilst Rory meet a young birdwatcher in her garden. Chantelle and Rory’s fact files help answer all of Harriet’s questions. With the help of the Teeny Tiny Creatures poem we discover that, like lots of other teeny tiny creatures, blue tits are superheroes and help our planet in their own special way. In the Teeny Tiny Task, Chantelle and the children make blue tit masks and have fun flying around the school grounds.

programme.title: Our Family
programme.desc: George and Freddie plan a woodland adventure. They create a list of all the things they’d like to see and find and pack some snacks for their intrepid journey. On their adventure with Mum and Dad, they discover colourful leaves, trees to climb, and bugs under rocks. But will they escape the treacherous troll hiding under the bridge? Back at home, there’s time for a warming cup of hot chocolate before settling down to bed.

programme.title: Big Cook Little Cook
programme.desc: Small is trying to grow a sunflower so she can enter it into the tallest sunflower competition. Big Cook's Big Cookery Book gives them a sunflower-inspired recipe for Straw-berry the Scarecrow.

programme.title: Dog Squad
programme.desc: Newfoundland Sylvie is a big therapy dog with big soft cuddles who loves to help people when they’re worried. She and her owner, Katrina, visit all sorts of people every day, young and old. Today, Sylvie and Katrina are visiting a doctor’s surgery to help a little boy called Ben. Ben has fallen off his scooter and grazed his knee, and his mum says he’s too nervous to come into the doctor’s room. Sylvie’s mission is to help Ben feel brave enough to see Dr Stevens. First, she gives Ben one of her biggest and best cuddles. Then, she and Dr Stevens show Ben how a doctor treats a patient. Sylvie loves performing in the starring role. Ben finally feels brave enough to go into the doctor’s room with his mum. But when Ben gets frightened and runs from the room, Sylvie must use all her superpowers to help him be braver still.

programme.title: Go Wild
programme.desc: Aneeshwar and Lizzie meet some European bison, including a large male called Loki. These bison are ten feet long and can weigh one tonne. They are the largest herbivores - or plant eaters - in Europe. Next, they meet two smaller but equally amazing animals - red-billed hornbills. This cheeky pair are the real-life versions of Zazu from the Lion King. With the hornbills perching nearby, Aneeshwar and Lizzie get to see these beautiful birds up close. Bison and hornbills are very different, but Aneeshwar and Lizzie discover what the unusual and extraordinary wild connection is between these two incredible animals.

programme.title: What's on Your Head?
programme.desc: Firefighter Karen shows us her fabulous helmet. We see how important it is for Karen to wear it while she does her heroic job, as well as some of the amazing things it does.

programme.title: Waffle's After School Club
programme.desc: The after schoolers want Waffle to win the Top Dog competition. But when Pepper needs help, Waffle is happy to step in and assist his sausage dog friend.

programme.title: Puffin Rock
programme.desc: Oona is nervous about her first dawn chorus and practises singing with Mama.

programme.title: Yukee
programme.desc: It’s been snowing in the garden, and Yukee helps Sonny find uses for a large collection of recycled bells.

programme.title: Lu & the Bally Bunch
programme.desc: Lu finds it hard to say goodbye to her favourite uncle.

programme.title: Piggy Builders
programme.desc: Fred and Dana come up with a new celebration - the Fine Forest Happy Helpers Day! They ask the Piggies to build a throne while baking a pie. Meanwhile, Wilf is determined to be rewarded and asks the Piggies for the impossible: to teach him how to help others.

programme.title: Numberblocks
programme.desc: Are you sitting comfortably? Then we'll begin a bedtime story all about Numberblocks Six to Ten. Learn all about the numbers 6, 7, 8, 9 and 10 with the Numberblocks.

programme.title: Alphablocks
programme.desc: Q sings I Need U, but she can't do it on her own. Unwilling U lends a hand - until all the quacking, quizzes and super quick piano playing drives him quackers... This episode introduces the letter Q and the pair Qu - and the words quack, quiz, quick and quit.

programme.title: Something Special
programme.desc: Mr Tumble gets messy decorating a cake. Maddie meets Alfie and Jack for a day out, and they play games and create paintings. There's some face painting fun in the spotty surprise. Featuring signs for the words ball, colour and paint.

programme.title: Teletubbies
programme.desc: A cloud appears in Teletubbyland and it begins to rain. Tinky Winky, Dipsy, Laa-Laa and Po watch the flowers bloom. Another cloud appears and it rains pink tubby custard!

programme.title: Ranger Hamza's Eco Quest
programme.desc: Ranger Hamza and the Ramblers discover how city parks play such an important role in the environment. They find out that green spaces in cities, like parks, can provide food and shelter for lots of animals and insects, and that parks can help keep cities cool. On the way, they spot an electric tram and have fun playing in the park!

programme.title: Maddie's Do You Know?
programme.desc: Today, Maddie is dressing up. She visits a barber to find out how clippers work to cut hair. Using a special microscope camera, Maddie shows us how the blades work, and a slow-motion camera lets us see the clippers in action. Next, Maddie visits a factory where ballet shoes are made. Using materials like satin and ribbon, Maddie sees how all the different cutters, sewing machines and hammers are used to put ballet shoes together.

programme.title: Grace's Amazing Machines
programme.desc: CBeebies’ very own motorbike rider Grace shows off three amazing machines that help make roads! Grace helps operate a road planer, checks out a road-printing machine and then has a go in a road paver!

programme.title: Time for School
programme.desc: It’s a cold day at school, and the children arrive wrapped up warm. At carpet time, Mrs Farrell asks them how animals keep warm in winter, and they talk about how they hibernate. Otto and his friends go to the forest area to look for signs of winter. Jud finds a toy bear, and the children decide to build a cosy home for it to hibernate in. Later, Jud, Leo and Leon cut out their very own paper snowflakes with help from Mrs Hussain - how will they turn out? It’s the end of the first term for the children in reception. Mrs Collins, Mrs Farrell and Miss Gerrard ask the class what they have learnt since they started school, before finishing the day with a group hug.

programme.title: Octonauts
programme.desc: Animated deep sea adventure series. Captain Barnacles and his intrepid band of explorers roam the oceans in search of adventure and fun. The Octonauts use magnets to try to stop a meteor that's heading toward the Octopod and get an assist from a rock-chomping humphead parrotfish and her friends.

programme.title: Peter Rabbit
programme.desc: When Mr Tod is trapped in Mr McGregor's garden, Peter reluctantly agrees to help him escape but soon learns that you should never trust a fox!

programme.title: Hey Duggee
programme.desc: Tag is feeling grumpy because he didn't eat his breakfast. Luckily, Duggee has his Breakfast Badge, so he can make whatever the Squirrels would like to eat – and it turns out they all like very different things for breakfast! The Squirrels learn all about how different animals fuel themselves in the mornings, earning their Breakfast Badges in the process. Tag finally gets his toast, helping power him through the day. Well done Squirrels!

programme.title: Piripenguins
programme.desc: The Piris are convinced a seal colony is planning to take over the berg, so they infiltrate the seal group to gather evidence. But as panic spreads, are their suspicions justified?

programme.title: Supertato
programme.desc: Supertato is out chasing a milkshake robot and leaves Broccoli in charge of Tato Tower. Evil Pea tries to take over the tower, but Broccoli puts on a great defence.

programme.title: The Weasy Family
programme.desc: The ducklings want to take a beautiful family portrait with their pop, but Weasy can’t help making faces and monkeying around. The ducklings decide to take a surprise photo of him so that he’ll look natural.

programme.title: Mojo Swoptops
programme.desc: Betty’s new ice cream flavour is so light, it makes everybody in town float in the air. How will Mojo and Bo get everyone’s feet back on the ground? By floating up there with them!

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: Dad agrees to play sheepdog with Bluey and Bingo to stop them from disturbing Mum.

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: When Bluey and Bingo visit Grandad, he takes them on an adventure into the bush.

programme.title: Zog
programme.desc: Winton has terrible toothache but isn’t ready to lose his fang. Zog and the doctors must help him feel proud again of the way he looks.

programme.title: Balamory
programme.desc: PC Plum must find the bird eating his prized strawberries. With Ava’s bird translator, he discovers it’s a chiffchaff and, after making friends with the bird, decides to share.

programme.title: Waffle the Wonder Dog
programme.desc: It's the hottest day of the year and Waffle is eating ice cream to cool down. Outside in the sweltering heat, Simon turns on the sprinkler to help everyone cool down, but poor Waffle doesn't like the sprinkler and darts through the hole in the fence to Mrs Hobbs's garden, looking for shade. The Brooklyn-Bells try to coax him back, but he refuses to return.

programme.title: Rafi the Wishing Wizard
programme.desc: Rafi and Dash want Jake to dance, but he’s too busy working. When Rafi makes a wish, Jake can’t stop air guitaring, tangoing and break dancing across the bakery kitchen!

programme.title: JoJo & Gran Gran
programme.desc: JoJo discovers that Gran Gran used to be in a band with Grandad and decides that she wants to learn how to play the drums. Gran Gran teaches JoJo how to play to a beat, and eventually they form a new band with Jared and Cynthia called JoJo and the Jammers!

programme.title: Sarah & Duck
programme.desc: Sarah and her best friend Duck embark on simple but exciting adventures, exploring the world both near and far in their own wobbly and imaginative way. When their local park is closed, Sarah and Duck try to find a suitable alternative.

programme.title: Clangers
programme.desc: A space tortoise is woken up by a mysterious tune Tiny first heard coming from the sky.

programme.title: BeddyByes
programme.desc: MeMo and BaBa discover a dandelion clock and have fun blowing the seeds. At Play Time, they choose another fuzzy flower to play with and bounce on a cloud whilst batting the flower about. The Yummies show MeMo and BaBa how to plant dandelion seeds, and MeMo and BaBa marvel at how a seed can become a beautiful flower. They travel across the Lullaby Lake, making their way to the Bay of Books.

programme.title: In the Night Garden
programme.desc: In a magical forest, colourful characters have adventures and are read stories. Everybody is running about in the garden so much that Makka Pakka can't wash faces. After a lot of fun and chasing, they all come together and Makka Pakka succeeds in his task.

programme.title: CBeebies Bedtime Stories
programme.desc: Rose Ayling-Ellis signs a Bedtime Story about Little Bear, who is deaf and struggling to understand the world around him.

programme.title: Evidence of the Unexplained
programme.desc: Accounts of an amphibious UFO in Indonesia a mass abduction in Australia a slew of deaths in Wales after a strange sighting searching for an alien library with an astronaut and meeting a scientist hunting for an interdimensional portal.

programme.title: Evidence of the Unexplained
programme.desc: Taking a look at strange crafts flying over power plants, airports and the Royal Palace in Sweden, a veteran with supposed UFO-related health issues and footage shown at a US congressional hearing.

programme.title: Evidence of the Unexplained
programme.desc: Investigating reports of UFOs massed over the South China Sea, ancient carvings of alienlike humanoids, and Albert Einstein's secret 1947 visit to Roswell, New Mexico.

programme.title: Evidence of the Unexplained
programme.desc: A look at a series of metal cubes seen spinning in the sky over Earth exploring the origin of an angel-shaped apparition China's interest in aliens a metal alloy that may power UFOs scareships.

programme.title: Evidence of the Unexplained
programme.desc: A mysterious doorway on Mars victims of a UFO in the Amazon an alien party crasher at the Queen's Jubilee in London animal mutilations in France a video of otherworldly visitors to Turkey.

programme.title: A River Runs Through It
programme.desc: Two brothers rebel against their stern father and become men in the majesty of the Montana wilderness.

programme.title: The Natural
programme.desc: A middle-aged unknown comes seemingly out of nowhere to become a legendary baseball player.

programme.title: Wild Pyrenees
programme.sub-title: The Pirate Of The Mountains: The Bearded Vulture
programme.desc: Who are those brave, ready to face valiantly these snowstorms, this freezing humidity which never leaves you when it seizes you? They are golden eagles. Their wingspan exceeds two meters. Even from this distance, you can feel the power of the animal. Behind this royal dance hides the hunting instinct of a super predator. However, on the ground, prey is scarce at the end of winter. My eye is drawn to an aerial gathering. I can't count them all. They are vultures, the first raptors to be served on the remains.

programme.title: Namibia
programme.desc: With more than 300 days a year, the sun dominates this country so much that it's even shining from their flag. It's a barren land, sometimes like from another planet but still familiar. A land of contrasts and colours with wide landscapes and fascinating deserts. Influenced by various cultures during colonization and now reborn from the shadows of Apartheid in 1990, Namibia gives a beautiful collage of culture, language, art, music, and food.

programme.title: Aiport Animal Stories
programme.desc: Let's observe the unknown airports' wildlife. When rabbits and foxes play a role in the airport's ecosystem and are protected by scientists, others could be a threat to the planes' safety

programme.title: Shetland's Otters: The Tale of a Draatsi Family
programme.desc: The stunningly wild and remote Shetland Islands are home to the highest density of otters in Europe. But despite their numbers, otters are extremely shy and are rarely seen.

programme.title: Asia
programme.sub-title: Secret Lives, Hidden Places - Kinabatangan River: Borneo - Forgotten Paradise
programme.desc: The Kinabatangan winds for over 560 kilometres across the north of Borneo. Nowhere else in Sabah live as many wild and rare animals as along the river: Orang-Utans, Elephants, crocodiles and proboscis monkeys. But the biodiversity is endangered because more and more palm oil plantations replace the rainforest. The natives fight for the preservation of the forest and the unique wildlife.

programme.title: Costaki Economopoulos
programme.desc: For 20 years Costaki has been living his dream as a full-time stand up comic. He has written jokes for Bette Midler, Jay Leno, MTV, and BET. You may have seen him on Showtime or heard him on Sirius, but you probably know him best from his regular appearances on the nationally syndicated Bob & Tom Radio Show.

programme.title: Rahn Hortman
programme.desc: Rahn credits the earliest influences to his humor to Bill Cosby and Martin Lawrence. Bill Cosby's ability to tackle diverse subject matter without uttering a single curse word, and Martin Lawrence's natural gift of representing the "ordinary guy" combined to form the foundation for Rahn's vision. What resulted is a unique blend of profanity-free banter, with pointed observations about everyday people that leave no one safe.

programme.title: Keith Stubbs
programme.desc: Keith Stubbs is a 'triple threat' in showbiz and entertainment. He's a hilarious stand-up comedian, talented actor, and award-winning radio personality.Keith was twice voted 'Best Comedian' by City Weekly, the Standard-Examiner named him 'Funniest Comic' and he was a semi-finalist in Comedy Central's Laugh Riots comedy competition. The Utah-based comic has made television appearances on A&E's An Evening at the Improv, nationally syndicated Comedy.TV, ABC's America's Funniest People and has established himself as a funny, improvisational comic, host, roastmaster and emcee.Keith tours nationally and has shared the stage with showbiz legends Joan Rivers, Jeff Foxworthy, Bill Cosby, Jim Gaffigan, Sinbad, Gladys Knight, and Frank Caliendo. Keith was one of five comedians who performed for the athletes in the Olympic Village at the 2002 Winter Games.Keith was named Best Actor by City Weekly for his show-stopping, comedic performance as 'Vinnie Black' in the stage production of Tony 'n Tina's Wedding. Stubbs currently plays Rob Schneider's accountant in the TV series "Real Rob" on Netflix.For eight consecutive years, Keith was awarded "Best Radio Personality" by the Utah Broadcasters' Association for his time spent as host of "The Stubbs Show" on 101.5 The Eagle. He also hosted KEITH STUBBS SPORTS on ESPN700 in Salt Lake City and appeared nationally on CMT radio and the Blue Collar Comedy channel on SiriusXM.Keith is often recognized for being a clean comedian, although his audiences span a broad spectrum. One review said, "Keith was funny, period! He was clean but we hardly noticed because his comedy and style are so unique and spot on."

programme.title: Dry Bar Comedy
programme.desc: David Harris is a nationally touring, regionally Emmy Award Winning comedian, magician, actor, and host. Harris has entertained North American audiences for over 20 years with over 2000 live performances to date. He regularly appears at clubs, colleges, corporate events, theaters, arts centers, alternative rooms and other top venues across the U.S. and Canada.

programme.title: BT
programme.sub-title: My Life As I Know It Now
programme.desc: With an act that crosses all boundaries, B.T. will surely have you rolling with laughter. His physical performance style and charm landed him two performances on NBC's Friday Night Videos and a performance at the prestigious HBO U.S. Comedy Arts Festival. B.T. has also appeared on BET's Comic View, MTV's The Jenny McCarthy Show, and FOX's The Keenan Ivory Wayans Show.

programme.title: Andy Peters
programme.desc: Andy Peters will get you. Where you sit, stand or hide. Wherever. Peters is a stand- up comedian who enjoys getting to the audience like no other. Along with his typically irreverent topics, he has the skills to go off script and still get the laughs. Fearless and often off-the-cuff. He won the Rocky Mountain Laugh-Off, was a Finalist in the Seattle International Comedy Competition and participated in the San Francisco Comedy Competition, Bridgetown and Just For Laughs Chicago Comedy Festival. Andy's debut Stand Up Special, Exclamation Mark Question Point is out now on Comedy Dynamics Film and A Special Thing Records. He can now also be seen as Coach Peters on the hit TruTV series Those Who Can't After years as a stand-out in the Seattle comedy scene, Peters now calls Los Angeles his home.

programme.title: Chris Voth
programme.desc: Chris Voth is an accomplished comedian, a licensed teacher, and a published author. Voth made his debut late-night television appearance on the Late Late Show with Craig Ferguson. He also appeared in three seasons of NBC's Last Comic Standing and was chosen for the prestigious Great American Comedy Festival. A 15-year comedy veteran, Voth is a past winner of the Denver Comedy Works Competition and has worked with everyone from Dave Chappelle to Larry the Cable Guy to Linda Ronstadt. Voth's first comedy CD titled "Never Mind the Jim J Bullocks, Here's the Chris Voth" is currently available for purchase. Chris currently balances his performance schedule with his full-time high-school teaching career. You can read his short story, "Stand Up and Deliver," published in the Cream City Review Literary Journal. In it, Chris shares the experiences he had when entering the teaching field after years in stand-up comedy.

programme.title: Andrew Hobbs
programme.desc: Have you ever, as an adult, been bullied by a healthcare professional or popular middle school girl? Andrew has. The comedy of Andrew Hobbs encapsulates the bizarre awkwardness of belated maturity and his attempts to appear in control. Andrew will have you rolling with laughter as he twists a narrative of humor and heart from his own life experiences and observations. His comedy has been featured in comedy festivals across the country. He has been perfecting his craft since childhood and throughout adulthood.

programme.desc: El esposo de una mujer casada con una vida perfecta engaña a su hermana, con consecuencias extremas.

programme.title: Proscrito
programme.desc: Un ex miembro del Royal Marine Commando descubre pruebas que podrían derribar a un funcionario corrupto y ponerlo tras las rejas de por vida. Cuando secuestran a su novia de la infancia, su misión es rescatarla y dejar que todo se interponga en su camino.

programme.title: Barcelona Noche de Invierno
programme.desc: Durante la Noche de Reyes, varias personas viven diferentes historias de amor, algunas alocadas e inusuales, y otras agridulces. Por un lado, un joven organiza una fiesta para recuperar a su exnovia, mientras que, paralelamente, el rey Melchor salta de la carroza en medio de la cabalgata para perseguir a una chica. Por otro lado, una abuela quiere compartir su secreto con toda la familia.

programme.title: Diddy: La Caída El Monstruo
programme.desc: El magnate del hip-hop caído en desgracia, Sean "Diddy" Combs, ya no pudo comprar su salida de los problemas cuando un gran jurado lo acusó en septiembre de 2024 de una conspiración de crimen organizado que incluía tráfico sexual, trabajo forzado y soborno. Sin fianza, iba a la cárcel.

2018 es un thriller de supervivencia en malayalam basado en las devastadoras inundaciones de Kerala de 2018. La película entrelaza múltiples vidas: un exmilitar convertido en comerciante, una reportera de televisión, un camionero y funcionarios del gobierno, cuyos caminos se cruzan en medio de la calamidad. A medida que suben las aguas, la gente común se convierte en héroe, arriesgando sus vidas para salvar a vecinos, desconocidos y comunidades.

programme.title: Cerco de Terror: Ataque Al Templo
programme.desc: Inspirada en hechos reales, la película narra la história heroica de los comandos NSG, que intervienen para salvar a personas inocentes cuando los terroristas atacan un templo en Gujarat.

programme.title: Linea del Condado: Todo o Nada
programme.desc: El asesinato de un dudoso abogado en la línea condal, obliga a dos sheriffs a dejar sus diferencias de lado para atrapar al asesino.

programme.title: Boogie: El Aceitoso
programme.desc: Boogie es un asesino a sueldo violento, despiadado y de sangre fría que sigue sus propias reglas. Las mujeres lo aman, los criminales le temen y su habilidad para matar le precede. Explotando con ironía, alcohol y balas ininterrumpidas, esta es una película animada en 3D asombrosa y llena de acción.

programme.title: USS Seaviper: Mision al Abismo
programme.desc: El submarino alemán U-234, del puerto de Kiel, comercia con los japoneses. El USS Seaviper debe localizar y detener este peligroso intercambio. El capitán del USS Seaviper debe desembarcar para realizar un reconocimiento en una isla cerca de Sumatra, pero el barco queda en manos de Mister Cutter, después de que el oficial ejecutivo resulta herido en batalla. Un conflicto entre Cutter y el jefe del barco pone al submarino en peligro. Seaviper está atrapado debajo de la superficie, con menos oxígeno, y un destructor japonés los caza desde arriba. Los daños sufridos por el barco también ponen en duda su supervivencia. Deben luchar contra el destructor japonés y llevar la información sobre el U-235 a Pearl Harbor.

programme.title: Asesinato en el norte, Temporada 7
programme.desc: En una obra de demolición, el vagabundo Jan Steinert observa a un hombre que esconde una bolsa de deporte verde mientras huye de la policía. Cuando el hombre desaparece, Steinert encuentra el botín del atraco a un banco: ¡53.000 euros! Sin que nadie se dé cuenta, Steinert coge el dinero y deja la bolsa.

programme.title: Asesinato en el norte, Temporada 7
programme.desc: Finn investiga por su cuenta tras ser suspendido por herir a un menor armado, hijo de un dueño de burdel.

programme.title: Asesinato en el norte, Temporada 7
programme.desc: Harry Siebert, instalador de paneles de yeso, es encontrado muerto a golpes en una obra. Su mujer, Klara, da la primera pista a los detectives: su marido quería reunirse con el jefe de obra, Jens Weigand, para reclamar su salario de los meses anteriores. Como Weigand quería aplazar de nuevo el pago, Harry se enfrentaba a la ruina económica.

programme.title: Asesinato en el norte, Temporada 7
programme.desc: Silke Bruhn, de 16 años, aparece muerta en el río Trave. Las primeras investigaciones revelan que fue golpeada antes de morir. Finn y Lars descubren rastros de un picnic en la orilla del río. ¿Se peleó la chica con un chico durante una cita? La madre de Silke y su hermano mayor, Niko, están completamente sorprendidos: Silke quería pasar la noche con su nueva novia.

programme.title: Asesinato en el norte, Temporada 7
programme.desc: Nadia Mönning, esposa de un reputado cardiocirujano de Lübeck, sorprende a un ladrón en su casa. Se enfrenta al hombre con una pistola y está a punto de llamar a la policía cuando el ladrón se revela. Se trata del fisioterapeuta de Nadia, Kai Thieme. En ese momento, el suegro de Nadia, Horst Mönning, enfermo terminal, llega para ayudarla.

programme.title: Asesinato en el norte, Temporada 7
programme.desc: Franziska aparece muerta en el coche de su marido en coma; sus hijastros podrían dejar el crimen impune.

programme.title: Asesinato en el norte, Temporada 7
programme.desc: Vanessa Kühn, una colegiala de 16 años, escapa por los pelos de un intento de secuestro. Una joven que intentó ayudarla resulta gravemente herida en la cabeza. Los detectives temen que el autor vuelva a intentarlo. Ordenan protección policial para Vanessa, que dirige un exitoso canal de belleza como influencer.

programme.title: Cerco de Terror 26/11 – La Serie
programme.desc: Lo que al principio parece violencia de pandillas se convierte en un ataque terrorista coordinado. Varios lugares de Mumbai — CST, Café Leopold, Hotel Taj, Oberoi y Chabad House — son atacados al mismo tiempo. Parvati aprovecha el caos para demostrar su valentía periodística.

programme.title: Go Astro Boy Go!
programme.desc: Mientras el Dr. Blunt realiza un experimento de telepatía con una chinchilla, que deja su mente temporalmente atrapada en el cuerpo del animal, el Equipo Astro investiga los misterios del teatro "embrujado". Suzu sube al escenario y canta. ¡Ay! Astro y Astro-Kitty piensan que su voz chillona debería ser suficiente para espantar a cualquier fantasma, pero los ruidos inquietantes continúan hasta que el Equipo Astro descubre al enamorado Derek, un ave lira capaz de reproducir cualquier sonido humano, los cuales incorpora en una canción con la esperanza de atraer a una pareja. Él y Suzu cantan a dúo y casi "echan abajo el teatro" cuando sus voces funden el cableado defectuoso de los micrófonos y provocan un incendio. El Equipo Astro apaga el fuego y salva el teatro y, para sorpresa de todos, la canción de Derek le consigue una pareja.

programme.title: Hecho en Chinatown
programme.desc: Es Goodfellas y Ip Man cuando un joven chino don nadie se propone convertirse en Don de la mafia italiana. Pero las tensiones ya son altas entre las dos culturas a medida que se mueven en el territorio del otro y un comisionado de delitos sucios juega en ambos lados. Resulta que ganarse el respeto, encontrar el amor y descubrir su identidad no es tan fácil. Tendrá que luchar para llegar a la cima.

programme.title: La Lucha de un Guerrero
programme.desc: Om es un súper comando que tiene la importante misión de devolver al Rashtra Kavach (que literalmente se traduce como guardia de seguridad del país) a buenas manos y salvar la nación. Está a punto de completar su misión cuando recibe un disparo y vuelve a la vida solo para darse cuenta de que ha perdido la memoria. Mientras tanto, Kavya Sharma se ocupa de él mientras otros funcionarios de la agencia gubernamental de élite, Murthy y Jai Rathod, están ocupados pensando cómo hacer que Om regrese a la misión. Pero no es tan sencillo como parece desde fuera. Mientras salva a su nación, Om tiene mucho más por descubrir: por ejemplo, encontrar a su padre Dev Rathod y demostrar que no era un traidor.

programme.title: Eva Braun
programme.desc: Fue solo después de su muerte que Eva Braun saltó a la fama en Alemania. Junto con Adolf Hitler, el 30 de abril de 1945 se quitó la vida en el búnker bajo la Cancillería del Reich en Berlín. El día anterior, el dictador se había casado con Braun, su amante durante muchos años. Apartada del mundo, Eva Braun pasó la mayor parte del tiempo en Múnich o en la residencia Berghof de Hitler en los Alpes. Después de la guerra, Albert Speer, antiguo arquitecto de Adolf Hitler, describió a Braun como una de las "decepciones de la historia". La primera biografía científica de Heike Görtmaker busca revisar la imagen de la rubia y apolítica figura al lado del Führer.

programme.title: Cold Case Files

programme.title: Cold Case Files Classic
